comment: The foreign downcalls this jar makes, by shape: tty/LinuxPty's libc calls (posix_openpt, grantpt, unlockpt, close;
ptsname_r; ioctl(TIOCSWINSZ), variadic after the request; read, write; kill). Every one is listed, including the
shapes other jars happen to register too, so a terminal never depends on what else is on the class path.
